description: Extract and structure a web page into clean JSON. Returns text, tables, prices, contacts, hours, ratings, dates, links, and images. Handles JavaScript-rendered SPAs and bot-blocked sites. Requires an API key (from register) or x402 payment. Cached URLs are free.

api_key.description: API key from register (cpk_ prefix). Required for uncached URLs unless using x402.

tx_hash.description: Transaction hash for x402 payment proof (alternative to API key)

name: extract_url
